wins: Agent consistently extracted artifacts from accessible hosts when mentor guidance provided.

Metric tracking captured precise reward improvements (60.0) indicating consistent baseline performance.
fails: Zero percent success rate implies inability to achieve goal objectives despite full episode.

key_outcomes.summary: Run achieved stable execution but failed to accomplish objectives; leverage mentor-driven insights to formalize autonomous tactics and reduce dependency.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Missing follow-up enumeration after initial host discovery, leading to stalled objective completion and repeated mentor calls.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and log fingerprint

skill_cards.if_condition: When host scan returns services but no credentials collected
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger structured follow-up probing using service-specific enumeration (http-enum, smb-os-discovery).

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor guidance issued for stalled progress
skill_cards.then_action: Translate mentor hint into concrete action plan with checklist and execute next step before requesting new hint.
